balls.text: overpitched outside off and Morkel picks it early and scoops it over mid-off, raw power takes it to the rope, the fielder was wide
yorker on middle and leg and he clips it down to square leg
and Raina walks back believing he's scored a ton! He makes room and scoops it over backward point and Smith runs back and hangs on to a really tough catch and falls forward
take that! It's a low full toss and he makes room and cracks it past extra cover, he reckons he's got to three figures and starts celebrating! Well apparently the giant scoreboard got it wrong
good inswinging yorker and Dhoni squirts it out to cover
mistimes the slog and the ball rolls wide of short fine leg
short outside off and slapped with brute force to deep extra cover, that looked like four the moment he hit it
that was harsh, comes round the wicket and Raina swings and misses, not that wide to be penalised  I'm afraid

Raina gets a life! He swings to long-on and the ball may have just fallen short of Trivedi but he recovers well enough to hurl a flat throw to the keeper, Rawat whips off the bails and Raina dives and makes his ground
the slower ball really stops on him and he stays at the crease and thumps it to long-off
Dhoni fails to pick up the slower one this time as he makes room, swings and misses
works it across the line wide of midwicket and pushes hard for the second run and makes it
that's a good slower ball and he picks it from outside off and places it to fine leg
and another chopper shot but along the ground this time to long-on
Free Hit: It's a catch though, Dhoni chases a full ball outside off and Dhoni plays that hilarious chopper shot, the ball is skied to Smith at long-off, they take 2
that's an overstep! Raina taps it wide of the bowler for a single and Kamran dives and hurts his ankle
that disappeared before you could blink! Raina gets under the bounce to a full delivery and thwacks it with force over extra cover, much flatter this time and a hapless Trivedi palms it over the rope
Raina the stylist again! Full and wide outside off and Raina stays at the crease, kneels down and scoops him high over deep backward point
full outside off and crashed to long-off
and finally Dhoni opens up! He picks a pitched up delivery on the pads and whips him away just over the rope at long leg, you should have seen the bat speed on that, amazing
driven hard and a misfield at cover allows 2 runs
slower ball on the pads and he clips it with ease wide of midwicket, lots of power on the shot as the ball scorches away
excellent placement! Raina gets under the bounce to a pitched up delivery and scoops it in the tiny gap between deep cover and deep extra cover and Quiney makes a mess of the ad hoardings
loses control of the radar and slips a yorker wide outside off, Trivedi somehow gets away with a wide
the slower ball and Dhoni checks his shot and tucks it down to long-on
gets on his knee and mows him down  to long-on
gets on his knee early and sweeps to deep square leg
full on the pads and worked wide of midwicket
a circumspect Dhoni actually shoulders arms, how often would you see that?
sweeps a little too early and the ball clips his pads and rolls to the on side
really short and he biffs it to the off side but can't beat cover
comes down the pitch and works it down to midwicket
short and pulled along the turf to long leg and it's only a single
slides down leg and it just clips his pad before dropping short of Rawat who fumbles
short and wide outside off and asking to be biffed, Raina works his wrists and thumps it well wide of backward point
fullish on the pads and pushed to mid-on
short and wide and angling across the right hander, Dhoni can't resist a slash and he fails to make contact
short and in the slot to pull but he doesn't time it too well, long-on picks it up
the quicker and straighter one and he gets well forward and defends to the off side
reaches out and pushes it to point
uses his feet and knocks it to long-on and Raina signals to Dhoni to stay put for the second run
nudges it wide of midwicket and they take the risk with the second run and Raina is struggling, he dives and Rawat whips off the bails and the decision is referred
tries the same shot but he finds cover this time
brute power! He rocks back to a short delivery and slaps it hard in the air and bisects the window between cover and extra cover
full outside off and squeezed past the diving short cover fielder

Mascarenhas hangs on to a difficult skier! Oram makes room to pound a straight six but he fails to make proper contact and the ball is skied down to wide long-off, Mascarenhas cups it over his head and tumbles backwards
rolls his wrists and times it well wide of point
chases a wide delivery and ends up chopping it to warne who dives at cover
gets beside the line and taps it wide of point and takes off for a quick single
cramps him for room as he shapes to dab it wide of the keeper and he misses it, this pitch is asking questions
slow through the air and he defends it away
wide down the leg side and he offers no shot
drops it short and he makes room and he ,makes room and punches it to cover
works it with  the turn to long-on for a single
shapes to sweep but he fails to make contact
gently pushes it down the track

Warne tosses it up very slowly and invites Badri to charge down the track but the turn foxes him and it's an easy stumping for Rawat, Badri failed to get to the pitch of the ball and credit to Warne for cutting back on the pace
slower ball again and he opens the face of the bat this time and steers it to third man
slower ball and Badri's completely beaten as he makes room
chips it very slightly in the air towards short midwicket, the ball stopped on him
keeps it on a good length and straight, he gets behind the line and pats it back down the pitch
opens the face of the bat and dabs it very late down to deep point
fullish outside off and punched off the front foot to deep cover
Rains rocks on the backfoot to seize on a short delivery and slaps it wide of cover, there's a big gap and he exploits it, that's his fifty as well!
works his wrists and works it against the turn to midwicket
driven to extra cover for a single
yet another misfield! Raina kneels down and clubs a short ball down to deep midwicket, Asnodkar over runs it and makes a mess of it
gives it a lot of air and Badri chases it and gets an inside edge to the on side after originally attempting to drive straight
waits for the turn and nudges it wide of short fine leg
excellent adjustment! The ball is short and Badri thinks of letting it go at first but then cheekily decided to upper cut it wide of the keeper, not a bad ball, the bowler was a touch unlucky
fires a yorker outside off and he digs it out to third man
not the most attractive of shots, he makes room and swings blindly but manages a thick inside edge which beats the keeper and runs down to fine leg
very well played, the ball slides down leg and Raina shuffles and deliberately gets a faint trickle past the keeper
he gives him the charge and slams it off the meat of the bat past the covers and a brilliant diving attempt by Yusuf cuts off a boundary
rush of blood as Badri kneels down slightly and attempts a flashy drive through the covers and misses it completely
extra bounce this time and the ball zips past Raina as he attempts a flashy cut
works his wrists and clips it softly in front of midwicket and completes an easyu single
the ball keeps a bit low and stops a bit but he gets behind the line and taps it to mid-off
gets beside the line and steers him wide of backward point
keeps low and a thick under edge rolls to the keeper
Raina's a stylist alright! He gets on one knee to a full delivery and he somehow gets underneath the bounce and scoops it rows over deep backward point
closes the face of the bat and tucks him wide of midwicket
pushes a low full toss to midwicket

this time Badri stands tall gets on top of the bounce and punches it wide of backward point, third man lets it slip between his legs, sloppy stuff, we've seen three such misfields today (counting the earlier match as well)
he drops it fuller and invites a flashy off drive, Badri's walking on a tightrope here
attempts a cheeky dab to third man despite a slip in place and nearly edges it to the keeper
stays at the crease, waits for the ball and steers it wide of point
full outside off and tapped to the off side for a single, Badri slides and the underarm flick is wide of the stumps
he's a stylish bloke! Yusuf fires this one full and Raina kneels down and scoops this one high over long-off
clips it towards midwicket and sets off very quickly
lovely placement, Badri makes a bit of room and waits for the spi, he gets on top of the bounce and cuts just wide of short third man
makes room and chops it to cover for another quick single
pushes it in front of mid-on and steals a quick single
keeps a touch low as he stays at the crease and taps it to mid-on
gets beside the line and slices it to backward point
gets forward and drives to cover
nice shot to relieve the pressure, he gets to the pitch of a full delivery and carves it over cover, the ball just drops short of the rope
gets on his knee and paddles it away and the ball sails towards third man, drops short
cramps him for room and he steers it to point, the keeper's still upto the stumps
punches it in front of mid-off and scampers to the other end, luckily the throw was wide of the stumps
stays back at the crease and punches it to cover
edgy again, the inside edge beats the stumps and Badrinath's now on strike
very tame dismissal, Patel tries to club a length delivery over the on side but swings way too early and the top edge goes down Kamran's throat at point
gives him the charge and knocks it down to short midwicket
knocks it back to the bowler
gives him room and this time Raina gets nicely beside the line and times and places the slice perfectly between point and cover
makes room and works it to the on side
into orbit! Out of the ground, Raina gets on his knee and plays his favourite slog which sends the ball to the clouds, don't ask me how they got the ball back this quickly
looks to drive but he gets a thick inside edge past the stumps, close call
sliced hard and Smith tumbles to his right at point and intercepts it
makes room and mistimes the shot to mid-on
pushed down the track
skids through and turns and gives Raina a bit of a shock, he backs away to cut and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads
he shuffles and nudges it wide of short fine leg
pushed back to the bowler

brilliant captaincy to bring on Yusuf this early! Hayden gives a lot of room hoping to carve him inside out over the off side but the ball lands on middle, goes through straight and the dislodges the furniture, Hayden kind of backed out of the shot in the last minute
tries to steer it to the off side and he ends up under edging it to the keeper
slices it on the up on the front foot with one hand and the ball drops short of the fielders
makes room and clips it down to midwicket
opens the face and dabs it down to third man and Asnodkar sprints, slides and pulls it back
drops it on the front foot to point and there' s a direct hit, Rawat appeals for a run out but Parthiv brings his bat down on time, it doesnt go upstairs
starts off with a wide one outside off and Parthiv chops it down to the off side
Raina rounds off a dream evening! Trivedi goes for the slog and the ball swirls in the air for an eternity before falling into Raina's hands at long-on
full outside off and crashes it straight to cover
He has a free swing of the bat and the thick outside edge flies past the keeper
slower delivery and placed to midwicket, only one result is possible here
drops it short on seeing the batsman back away and he dabs it down to third man
full on middle and leg and he swings to midwicket
just checks the pull and the ball drops short of midwicket
full outside off and he pushes it to long-off
Oram drops the ball short on seeing Munaf give room, he doesn't quite know what to do and he ends up handing a tame edge to Parthiv, Munaf walks
another one bites the dust and Chennai pretty much have this wrapped up, Warne tries to go over the top but he fails to get the elevation to clear long-off, Badri takes it easily
full outside off and pushes it hard to long-off
misdirects a slower ball wide down the leg side
Warne backs away to a slower ball and dabs it to third man

the man with the orange cap takes the skier, Jadeja attempts a massive slog which doesn't come off well, he picks it from outside off, gets on his knee and Hayden takes a skier at deep square leg, that was in the air for quite a while
he somehow manages to squirt out another yorker and the ball beats Balaji
superb inswinging yorker outside leg, Warne gets on his dancing shoes and fails to dig it out
makes room to a short delivery and upper cuts it just over Tyagi's reach at short third man
Dropped Warne pounds it right back to Oram and it travels at lightning speed, that stings him
brilliant bowling, Warne gives the charge and Oram drops it short and bowls another slower ball, the batsman misses again
foxes him with a slower ball and Warne slogs in despair and fails to get any wood on the ball
it's a low swinging full toss and Warne ends up thudding it back to the bowler
lands outside off and he slashes it wide of point
sweeps to Tyagi at short fine-leg and Jadeja sprints at the other end but manages to get back to his crease
skids and turns and he makes room and slashes it wide of point
makes room and cuts wide of backward point, it's a tester for sweeper cover
he takes the aerial route and deposits the ball several rows over deep midwicket, he slogs and picks it from outside off, super shot
skids through and he gets a thick under edge which lobs close to the stumps
Oram gets away with a full toss, Mascarenhas reaches out and ends up chipping it straight to Murali at short cover, not a wicket taking delivery and the batsman will regret that missed chance
slice of luck for Rajasthan, it's a yorker on the legstumps and Mascaranhas swings and gets a thick inside edge which beats short fine leg
exposes his stumps and Oram drops it really full, he doesn't get under the bounce and hence steers it to the sweeper cover fielder
he misses out on a opportunity to crash a full toss and he ends up playing it straight to cover
fires a yorker outside off and Mascaranhas fails to dig it out
makes room and Oram follows him by bowling it full on the stumps, he squeezes it to the off side
that's very close to a waist high no-ball but Baxter doesn't signal anything, Mascaranhas can afford a smile
gets in position a little too early on the pull and hence ends up chopping it to square leg
Morkel holds the length back outside off and gets it to fizz past the outside edge
slices it with soft hands into the gap at the covers and sprints away
gets beside the line and steers it to sweeper cover
full on middle and off and he shuffles and he clips it to deep square-leg
Balaji holds the length back slightly and Yusuf can't resist the temptation to go over the top, he clubs it hard and the ball travels flat and lands in Raina's safe hands at long-off
bowls it much fuller and he digs it out down the pitch
forget about chasing it, Balaji bowls it full and Yusuf makes a bit of room and bangs it hard along the turf to long-off, the fielder had no chance
this one keeps low and shoots along the pitch to the keeper
walks down the pitch and pushes it on the full, there's a misfield at cover
angles it across the right hander and he gets on his knee and slogs it with brute force, bisects the gap between deep square and deep midwicket
stays back, waits for it and dabs it towards short third man and Tyagi makes a mess of the dive
stays back, waits for the turn and clips it across the line
comes round the wicket and he gives the charge and powers it to long-on
gets on his knee and pushes it to midwicket
brute force and that travelled like lightning! He kneels down and sweeps against the turn and whams it to deep midwicket
clips a knee high full toss on its way to deep square leg and the ball really scorches towards the boundary and Oram does a splendid job
another yorker and Yusuf digs it out down the pitch
fires a yorker  and Yusuf just manages to squirt it out

Jadeja chases a really poor delivery - short and really wide outside off - and the outside edge flies thick and fast, Parthiv dives and claims the catch and Jadeja stands his ground, the third umpire gives the batsman the benefit of the doubt, it looked clean at first but the replay may have suggested something else
it's a low full toss wide outside off and he reaches out and pushes it to deep cover
short and wide and Jadeja should have ideally slashed that over the infield but he instead mistimes it to the sweeper
gives it more air and he swings on the up down to long-on
he fires it flatter and Yusuf swings early and gets a thick edge onto his pads
Yusuf Pathan plays in the manner he knows best, he swings his arms and slogs him over midwicket
that was fairly straightforward, comes round the wicket and the ball skids through and keeps low, he gets his front foot forward and is struck in line with the stumps, easy one for Gary Baxter
gets well forward and blocks it away
pushed towards cover for a single
lovely shot, he makes a fraction of room and cuts with the turn, there's a big gap in the region of third man and the sweeper can't mop it off
makes room and cuts it down to point
he chips it uppishly down to short midwicket
yet another doosra and he's a bit cramped for room as he cuts to point
down the leg side and wide called
Missed stumping He chips down the track and the flight fixes him, Dhoni fails to gather the ball properly
chips down the track and he works it to long-on
angles it down the leg side and he sweeps to deep square leg
chips down the track and thumps it hard down the ground to long-on
shapes to sweep but misses
comes round the wicket and fires it flat and quick, he taps it to mid-on
another appeal for an lbw but he was well forward
the doosra really skids through and they appeal for an lbw thinking it was pad first and then bat, close but a good decision
full on middle and off and he clips it to the on side with a flick of the  wrists
the doosra, he nudges it off his pads
tucks it to the on side and they push hard for the second run, the fielders should have been more alert
lands it outside leg and he clips it off his pads
overpitches just outside off and Quiney times this one crisply and places it in the arc between mid-off and cover, Quiney's been very impressive
he whips an offcutter from outside off and places it just wide of Oram at mid-on who misfields, sloppy fielding from an international player
full outside off and pushed to the off side

it's a hitwicket and a catch! Very unusual dismissal indeed, he pulls a short delivery and knocks the stumps with his bat on the follow through, Tyagi takes the catch at square leg probably not realising that Asnodkar had whacked his stumps
full outside off and he takes his bottom hand off the handle as he drives to cover
shuffles and clips it with the line wide of midwicket
that's the Asnodkar we all know! He seizes on a fractionally short delivery and clubs him over deep midwicket, he gets a lot of elevation, that should give him a lot of confidence
gives him width outside off and he opens the face and steers it down to third man
shuffles and tucks it with the angle wide of square leg
bowls the slower ball and Quiney's heart must have been in his mouth as he chipped it just wide of mid-on's reach
just opens the face of the bat and steers it wide  of point
hits a length just outside off and gets it to come back in, he defends down the track
in the slot to drive through the off side but he ends up jamming it down to Balaji at mid-off
the shorter one kicks up on Asnodkar who hops and fends it off to the on side
drops it fractionally short and he stands tall and slices it to third man who's square
keeps it outside off and he steers it to Badri at backward point who fumbles
gets beside the line and he squeezes it down to third man
Fires in a Yorker and Quiney keeps it out
on the middle and leg line, Quiney drives but gets an inside edge to fine leg for a single
outside the off stump, Quiney pushes it to the off side again
short on the leg stump. Quiney pulls but does not get any bat on it as it grazes the abdominal region on the way to fine-leg boundary
just a touch slower this time around. Quiney as is expected is early into the shot and manages to push it to the off side
on the middle stump, Quiney comes forward and pushes it to the leg side
outside the off stump, Quiney pushes it to the off side

one down! Albie tempts Smith into a false stroke this time as he bowls one wide outside the off stump. Smith goes for the drive and gets a thick outside edge to Badrinath manning the point region. Not the start Royals wanted
short outside the off stump, Quiney gets onto the backfoot and delays the shot just for a second as he runs it down to third man for a single
fuller delivery outside the off stump. Quiney opens the face of the bat at the last moment but can't clear Badrinath at point
good length outside the off stump. Smith plays it with soft hands to the off-side for a single
good length delivery outside the off stump. Smith is looking for the drive but is early into the shot and mistimes it to cover. He is frustrated with his own efforts
tucks him up with a good line outside the off stump. Smith gets behind the line and pushes it to point
that's an excellent lifter, really catches him by surprise and he does well to fend it off
works up a good pace and the ball thuds into Dhoni's gloves
fullish outside off and he times the drive brilliantly past mid-off and cover, more of a forward push
gets on him a lot quicker and he shuffles and tucks it to square leg
short and wide and sliced uppishly past backward point, Albie does brilliantly at third man to cut it off
well bowled, cramped for room and he gets beside the line and chops it to cover, Raina slides and cuts it off
lands it wide outside off and wide called, more of a loosener
